role: The ender chest block entity: only the viewer count and lid angle (the items live in the player's InventoryEnderChest), with the periodic block event and lid sounds.
scope_reason: Ender chests are craftable (obsidian and an eye of ender) and open the player's ender inventory.

members.name: updateEntity
members.note: The lid and its sounds; the every-20-tick block event carries the count as it is and the next tick's func_147488_Z writes it back after any open or close queued between (tileticks.c:ender_chest_update, world.c world_block_events_run), and the client's lid is stepped from the server count (play.c).

members.name: receiveClientEvent
members.note: The server's: world.c world_block_events_run sets the count to the event's parameter; the client lid steps from the server count (raster_tileents_lid_tick).
